search_text: 设 $f(x,y)$ 为连续函数，$D:\frac{x^2}{4}+\frac{y^2}{9}\leq1$，则二重积分 $\iint_Df(x,y)dxdy$ 的累次积分为[\quad] $\int_{-2}^2dy\int_{\frac23\sqrt{4-x^2}}^{\frac32\sqrt{4-x^2}}f(x,y)dx$ $\int_{-3}^3dy\int_{\frac23\sqrt{9-y^2}}^{\frac32\sqrt{9-y^2}}f(x,y)dx$ $\int_{-2}^2dx\int_{-\frac32\sqrt{4-x^2}}^{\frac32\sqrt{4-x^2}}f(x,y)dy$ $\int_{-3}^3dx\int_{-\frac23\sqrt{9-y^2}}^{\frac23\sqrt{9-y^2}}f(x,y)dy$ 解答 原式=$\int_{-2}^{2}dx\int_{\frac{3}{4}x^2}^{\sqrt{4-x^2}}f(x,y)dy$. 原式=$\int_{\frac{3}{2}}^{3}dy\int_{\sqrt{\frac{4}{3}y}}^{\sqrt{9-y^2}}f(x,y)dx$.
